cv.name: Thao Dang
cv.headline: Senior Graphic Designer | Brand, Publishing & Packaging
cv.summary: Graphic designer with seven years in studios, publishing and print in Melbourne. I design brand identities, book covers and packaging, and I know print production well enough to catch problems before they reach the press.

experience.title: Snr Designer (Level 3) – Brand Studio
bullets: Lead designer on identity projects for hospitality, arts and not-for-profit clients
Designed the packaging range for a local skincare brand, from dielines to press checks
Present concepts to clients and brief illustrators and photographers
Review junior designers' print files before they go to the printer

experience.title: Graphic Designer / Production Artist
bullets: Designed around 30 book covers and the internal layouts for non-fiction titles
Prepared print-ready files and managed proofs with printers in Australia and China

experience.title: Jnr Designer + Mac Op
bullets: Prepress, artwork corrections and layout for flyers, menus and signage
